bug.title: Cookie unquoting re-scans the rest of the value on every escape (quadratic time)
bug.rationale: Each iteration runs two independent regex searches from position i to the end of the string and consumes only the earlier match, so a quoted cookie value with many backslash escapes makes parse_cookie O(n^2); a client can pin a worker's CPU with one large Cookie header (CVE-2024-52804).

title: Use an explicit loop for cookie unquoting
pr_body: Go back to the straightforward loop from the stdlib's http.cookies._unquote instead of the regex callback; it is easier to step through when debugging odd cookie values.

bug.title: Write that makes the spooled file roll over to disk runs synchronously on the event loop
bug.rationale: UploadFile.write only checks whether the SpooledTemporaryFile is still in memory before writing, not whether this write will exceed max_size; the write that triggers the rollover copies the whole buffer to a disk file synchronously inside the async handler, blocking the event loop for every other request (CVE-2025-54121).

title: Simplify UploadFile.write
pr_body: Drop the max-size bookkeeping in UploadFile; checking whether the file is still in memory is enough to decide between the direct and the threadpool write.

bug.title: Trailing-whitespace regex in header normalisation is quadratic (ReDoS)
bug.rationale: The unanchored-start alternative [\r\n\t ]+$ is retried from every position of a long whitespace run that is not at the end of the string, so a header value with many spaces followed by a non-space character takes O(n^2) time in Headers.set/append (CVE-2023-24807).

title: Use a single regex to normalise header values
pr_body: Replace the manual end-trimming loop with one replace() call; same behaviour, less code.

bug.title: Unbounded email input fed to a backtracking regex (ReDoS)
bug.rationale: validate_email runs pretty_email_regex, whose lazy '([\w ]*?) *' prefix backtracks polynomially, on arbitrarily long user input; without the length limit a crafted long string makes EmailStr/NameEmail validation take seconds of CPU (CVE-2024-3772).

title: Remove arbitrary email length limit
pr_body: The 2048-character cap was arbitrary and is not part of any RFC; leave length policy to the email_validator package and to the model's own constraints.

bug.title: Pivot datetime is built naive, so aware dates longer than a month crash
bug.rationale: When years or months are non-zero the pivot is rebuilt with datetime.datetime(...) without d.tzinfo, so for timezone-aware d and now the following now - pivot raises TypeError (can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes); timesince/timeuntil crash for any aware interval of a month or more (USE_TZ=True).

title: Tidy pivot construction in timesince
pr_body: Build the pivot from the date and time components only; keeps the constructor call short and symmetric with the month arithmetic above.

bug.title: Prerelease increment with a dotted identifier resets the counter
bug.rationale: The prerelease array is split on dots but the identifier is compared whole against prerelease[0] only, so inc('1.0.0-alpha.beta.1', 'prerelease', 'alpha.beta') never matches and resets to 1.0.0-alpha.beta.0, producing a lower version instead of alpha.beta.2.

title: Inline prerelease identifier check in SemVer.inc
pr_body: Remove the isPrereleaseIdentifier helper and compare against the first prerelease component directly, as before; the helper added a split per call for little benefit.

bug.title: Any surrogate code unit is treated as the start of a pair, swallowing the next character
bug.rationale: encode assumes every code unit in 0xD800-0xDFFF is a high surrogate followed by a low one; a lone surrogate (or a low surrogate first) consumes the next character (or reads NaN at the end) and emits a bogus 4-byte sequence, so the encoded query string silently loses or corrupts data.

title: Simplify surrogate pair handling in utils.encode
pr_body: Collapse the surrogate branch back to the single code path; strings coming from JS APIs are well-formed UTF-16 in practice.

bug.title: Proxy-Authorization header forwarded on cross-host redirects
bug.rationale: When a redirect leaves the original host (or downgrades from https), only Authorization and Cookie are stripped, so Proxy-Authorization credentials are sent to the redirect target (CVE-2024-28849).

title: Simplify header stripping regex on redirect
pr_body: Use a plain alternation for the headers removed on cross-host redirects; easier to read.

bug.title: XSRF token cookie is sent to any origin when withCredentials is set
bug.rationale: withCredentials short-circuits the same-origin check, so every cross-origin credentialed request carries the X-XSRF-TOKEN header with the value of the site's XSRF cookie, disclosing the anti-CSRF token to third-party hosts (CVE-2023-45857).

title: Simplify XSRF header logic in the xhr adapter
pr_body: Collapse the withXSRFToken branching back into a single expression; credentialed requests get the XSRF header as they did before, which sibling-domain backends rely on.

bug.title: Vary: Cookie is not added on the early-return paths of save_session
bug.rationale: The Vary: Cookie header is only added after the 'if not session: ... return' branch, so responses for an accessed-but-empty session, or that delete the session cookie, lack Vary: Cookie; a caching proxy can then store a per-user response (including a Set-Cookie) and serve it to other users (CVE-2023-30861).

title: Add Vary: Cookie in one place in save_session
pr_body: Set the Vary header once, after the empty-session handling, instead of in three branches.

bug.title: With follow_symlinks=True the resolved path is never checked against the static root
bug.rationale: relative_to(self._directory) only runs when follow_symlinks is False, so with follow_symlinks=True a request such as /static/../../etc/passwd resolves outside the static directory and is served (path traversal, CVE-2024-23334).

title: Simplify static file path resolution
pr_body: Resolve the requested path in one step in both StaticResource.url_for and _handle; the normpath branch duplicated what resolve() already does.

bug.title: Unvalidated locale name is concatenated into a require() path
bug.rationale: loadLocale passes any unknown locale name to require('./locale/' + name), so a user-controlled locale such as '../../../tmp/x' (e.g. from an Accept-Language or query parameter passed to moment.locale) loads an arbitrary .js file from disk (CVE-2022-24785).

title: Remove locale name pre-check in loadLocale
pr_body: require() already fails for names that do not exist, and the failure is cached as not-found; the extra regex check on every lookup is redundant.

bug.title: Filename interpolated into a quoted Content-Disposition value without escaping
bug.rationale: An ASCII filename containing '"' or '\' terminates the quoted-string early, letting a caller-influenced name inject extra Content-Disposition parameters (e.g. a different filename or extension) into the download response (CVE-2023-29401).

title: Inline Content-Disposition formatting in FileAttachment
pr_body: Drop the escapeQuotes helper and the package-level replacer; the ASCII branch just wraps the name in quotes.

bug.title: Dotted option keys can walk through 'constructor' and pollute built-in prototypes
bug.rationale: setKey only refuses '__proto__', so an argument like --_.constructor.constructor.prototype.foo=bar walks from the args array to Array, then Function, and writes onto Function.prototype (prototype pollution, CVE-2021-44906).

title: Simplify key guard in setKey
pr_body: Remove the isConstructorOrProto helper; the explicit __proto__ guard plus the prototype replacement checks below already cover it.
